hero.body: Myanmar and Western dates, the moon, Sabbath days, holidays and astrology in one place — and printable calendars you design yourself.
hero.openWeb: Open the web app in your browser →

highlights.label: Highlights
items: Your events stay on your phone

features.title: Everything for every day
features.body: From Myanmar dates to astrology, from holidays to class timetables — on your phone, no internet needed.

items.title: 22 grid layouts, 12 themes
items.body: Myanmar and Western dates in one grid, with the moon, holidays, Sabbath days and your events on every day.

items.title: Astrology in plain words
items.body: The Myanmar date, Sasana year and moon, with countdowns to the next full moon, new moon and Sabbath day.

items.title: Holidays, timetables, reminders
items.body: Search and filter holidays and set reminders. Add weekly class timetables with a different time each day, or one event on several dates at once.

widgets.title: On your home screen and lock screen
widgets.body: Today's date, the moon and what's next at a glance, without opening the app. Five styles for iOS and Android.

studio.title: Design and print your own calendar
studio.body: Start from wall, desk, social and story presets and edit right on the page. Myanmar dates, moon days and holidays are already in place; export PDF, PNG or JPEG at real paper size.

languages.title: Six ways to write a date
languages.body: The full moon of Thadingyut, 26 October 2026, as the app writes it.
languages.zawgyiNote: Shows correctly with a Zawgyi font

items.a: Yes. Myanmar Calendar is free on Android, iPhone, iPad and the web.
Yes. Your calendar, events and settings are kept on your phone, so it works without the internet.
Your events and settings never leave your phone. Anonymous usage and crash reports are sent only if you allow them. See the privacy policy for details.
The app speaks Myanmar and English, and the calendar can be shown in Myanmar, English, Zawgyi, Mon, Shan and Karen.

items.q: How do I add a Studio template?
items.a: Download the file, then in Calendar Studio tap Import project, or New calendar → Import template, and choose it.

templatesPage.title: Calendar Studio templates
templatesPage.heading: Ready-made calendar designs
templatesPage.body: Download one, add it to Calendar Studio, swap in your photos, edit the words, and print.
templatesPage.description: Free Calendar Studio designs for couples, families, friends and businesses: {year} projects and templates for any year.

steps.title: Download a file
steps.body: .mmcstudio for this year, or .mmctemplate for any year.

steps.title: Open Calendar Studio
steps.body: Tap Import project, or New calendar → Import template, and choose the file.

steps.title: Add your photos
steps.body: Tap a photo frame, then Replace, to put your own photo in.

designs.love-letters: Cream paper, photos framed like stamps, a red wax seal and a "Dear ___," note each month.

designs.moonlit: Navy and gold: round moon photos, a crescent and stars.

designs.little-home: A little house with a photo in its window and a chores list. Kids love it.
designs.good-times: Tilted polaroids, star stickers and plans for the crew.
designs.postcards: Postcards, stamps and a next-trip list for friends who travel.
designs.clean-corporate: An office calendar with your logo, monthly goals and notes.
designs.studio-bold: A big month number, your logo, key dates and deadlines.
